# The Fashion Law

> > The Fashion Law is the leading source for legal news, analysis, and litigation coverage at the intersection of fashion, beauty, luxury, and intellectual property law.

The Fashion Law provides in-depth reporting on trademark disputes, copyright infringement cases, counterfeiting, brand protection, celebrity endorsements, and regulatory issues affecting major fashion houses like Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Dior, and emerging beauty brands. Coverage spans federal court cases, industry trends, and legal developments impacting designers, influencers, and luxury retailers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Trademark Infringement
- Intellectual Property
- Copyright Infringement
- Counterfeiting & Fakes
- Brand Protection
- False Advertising
- Consumer Protection
- Federal Trademark Law
- Luxury Brands (Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Dior, Balenciaga)
- Beauty & Cosmetics Litigation
- Celebrity & Influencer Law
- Authentication Disputes
- New York Federal Court
- Fashion Industry Regulation

- [The Supreme Court Says "No" to Kardashian Beauty Brand Trademark Case](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/the-supreme-court-says-no-to-kardashian-beauty-trademark-case): Supreme Court denies Kroma Makeup's trademark case against Kardashians
- [Costco Must Pay Tiffany & Co. $25 Million for Using its Name to Sell Diamond Rings](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/costco-has-to-pay-tiffany-amp-co-25-million-for-using-its-name-to-sell-diamond-rings): Costco ordered to pay Tiffany $25M for trademark infringement on diamond rings
- [Four Stripe Fight: Will FC Barcelona's Newest Thom Browne Uniforms Give Rise to a Legal Battle With adidas?](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/four-stripes-will-fc-barcelonas-new-thom-browne-uniforms-give-rise-to-a-fight-with-adidas): Thom Browne's four-stripe FC Barcelona suits may trigger adidas trademark dispute
- [Baby Sussex is Here, and the Question is: Royal Baby™?](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/baby-sussex-is-here-and-the-question-is-royal-baby): Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's baby raises celebrity name trademark questions
